clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather's death in July 1989, your mother began lying awake over money in March 1988 and stopped talking with your father about it by May 1988; after the death, your brother's grades fell in November 1989, and your mother grew calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts in your parents' distance over money in the months before his death, your brother's drop in functioning after it, and your mother's return to calm afterward sit together across these months.

clusters.name: Your mother told she had breast cancer, 1994–1996
clusters.reason: When you left for college in September 1993 and your mother was told of breast cancer in February 1995, you began calling your brother most nights in April 1994, stopped returning his calls by June 1995, and stopped calling home by February 1996; your migraines kept you in bed from March 1994 onward. Your symptom, your moves toward and away from your brother, and your distance from home cluster around your mother's diagnosis and the months after it, with no one else's shifts showing in these months.
